description:
Java. The most populous island on Earth. More than 150 million people call this place home. 
That's more the population of Russia, squeezed into a piece of land smaller than many American states. 
Vast cities blend into towns, towns merge with villages, and villages dissolve into an endless patchwork of rice fields.
